subject: literacy
concept: Writing dialogue with correct punctuation (quotation marks, commas) that sounds like real speech
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student adds punctuation tiles to unpunctuated dialogue to make it correctly formatted
exercise.pictorial: Student circles correctly punctuated dialogue among examples with errors
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short dialogue exchange between two characters with correct punctuation

misconception_flags: omits quotation marks or misplaces punctuation relative to the quotation marks

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
